description: The ideas DECA's engine wrote for your own workspace from what it knows about you (set in the dashboard under Settings → Your radar), each with why it is yours, and the day's public ideas it picked for you. Needs an API key; a key sees only its own workspace. Read only: it never asks the engine to write more. Free.

include.description: Ideas written for you, the day's picks for you, or both. Default both.

limit.description: How many of each to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

name: get_my_ideas
title: Ideas for your workspace
